verdict.rationale: Government digital services can plausibly publish their source code, so this question applies to an agency's online portals and is not a category error. The evidence pack covers only employer tax and filing guidance and failed probes (llms.txt, markdown docs, OpenAPI). Nothing mentions a public source repository or an open license for EAMS, eServices or the esd.wa.gov site.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
